item.title: Human trafficking suspect used drugs, woman's child to control her, Florida AG says
item.description: A man has been arrested on human trafficking charges after authorities said he took a woman across Florida and Mississippi, coercing her to engage in sexual acts for money and using her own child as a way to keep her captive.
